description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.001 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Messy text + JSON Schema in, clean JSON out. Uses a small LLM (Cloudflare Workers AI, Llama 3.1 8B, JSON mode) when available, else a deterministic key:value/regex extractor; the result is type-checked against your schema and missing fields are null. Limits: text <= 6,000 chars, schema <= 30 top-level properties (flat objects, arrays of scalars); the model can misread ambiguous text, so check important values. Params: text, schema (JSON string), mode=auto|heuristic. GET query or POST JSON body. When to use: Use extract-json for short free text with your own JSON schema; for invoices and receipts use invoice-json.

schema.description: JSON Schema (type object with properties) as a JSON string

name: extract_json

outputSchema.description: Inferred from a real response captured on 2026-10-24; extra fields may appear, null-valued fields are untyped.
